explanation: The arrows require dy/dx > 0 for y > 1 and y < -1, and dy/dx < 0 for -1 < y < 1, with equilibria at ±1. Equation I, y²−1, has exactly these signs and zeros. Equation II is negative below −1 and positive between −1 and 1. Equation III has no equilibrium at −1 and is never negative. Thus only I matches.
